entries.title: Your yes to a crewmate's check counts even after it keeps working
entries.body: When a crewmate asks you to allow a check and keeps working while the card waits, your Allow now counts for the version it has reached. Before, a new commit while the card waited threw your answer away and the crewmate had to ask again. When a question does change and the crewmate asks again, the new question now comes back on the same card, even if you closed the note left in its place.
entries.noPicture: This changes whether an existing card's answer counts, not how any view looks.
